name: exp_nonneg_of_one_le
statement: ∀ x : ℝ, 1 ≤ Real.exp x → 0 ≤ Real.exp x
docstring: Once the exponential clears `1`, it stays nonnegative: the threshold is what forces the sign.
why: The hypotheses are satisfiable (probe 1 quiet: `x = 0`), but the conclusion proves with the hypothesis deleted (`Real.exp_pos`), so probe 2 fires: the threshold the docstring calls load-bearing does no work. Trivial-statement shape, distinct from pair4's vacuous shape.
